summary: Lolo National Forest lookout in Missoula County: a 1934 50-foot L-4 pole tower, a cupola trailer from 1970, now gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 50-foot pole tower of the L-4 type; pop-up cupola trailer used from 1970
facts.status_note: Forest Lookouts index marks the tower gone; the firelookout.com page heads the lookout R.I.P. 1934-1970

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1934 notice calls the site Plateau mountain; firelookout.com and the Missoula County list call it Plateau Peak. Both list Lolo National Forest 14N-23W-4, so the two names are treated as one site. No third source confirms the link.

notes_for_editor: History rests on one narrative page (firelookout.com) plus a 1934 newspaper notice that names the site Plateau mountain. Identification with Plateau Peak rests on the shared township, range and section (14N-23W-4) and the 1934 date. No staffing, fire or current-site source was found, so those are left out of the story except the site-today sentence. Story is about 140 words including footnote-free body text. Used 2 searches and about 5 page reads.
